title: Soul Trapper
description:
A Windows port of the classic iOS audio adventure game Soul Trapper. The original game and its audio experience were created by Realtime Associates; this unofficial port was made with the help of AI.

The game speaks through NVDA when available, with Windows speech voices as a fallback. Tab repeats the current instructions, F1 gives contextual help, and F5 and F9 save and load a manual checkpoint.
